title: Solitude Beneath the Distant Palm
intro: Picture a quiet retreat far from familiar crowds, where devotion meets an extraordinary decree. A lone servant withdraws in purity and trust, sustained by unseen provision. Around this soul gather signs that defy ordinary explanation, while whispers of doubt wait beyond the place of seclusion. Step closer and listen, for the truth here will challenge every assumption.
clues: I devoted myself to worship in seclusion, sustained by provision from my Lord.
I received glad tidings that Allah had chosen me above all women of the worlds.
I withdrew to a remote eastern place, veiled from my people, when a spirit appeared to me in the form of a perfect man.
I conceived a child by a word from Allah though no man had ever touched me.
I endured labor alone beneath a palm tree and heard a voice comfort me with a stream beneath me and fresh dates to eat and drink.
I returned to my people carrying my newborn, held a vow of silence, and my infant spoke from the cradle to defend me as a servant of Allah.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Bilqis, ruler of Saba
The wife of Imran
The wife of Lut
Maryam
Asiya, wife of Pharaoh

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Led an exodus across the parted sea
Built an ark to survive the flood
Thrown into a blazing fire and saved
Miraculous conception and solitary birth under a palm
Swallowed by a great fish in the deep sea
trial.answer: Miraculous conception and solitary birth under a palm

location.label: Key Element
options: The palm trunk with a stream below
The ark resting on Mount Judi
The Kaaba in Makkah
The fire prepared by Namrud
The sacred valley of Tuwa
location.answer: The palm trunk with a stream below

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Swallowed by the earth with treasures
Destroyed by a thunderous blast for hamstringing the she-camel
Drowned with the army in the sea
Turned into apes for breaking the Sabbath
Vindicated when the newborn spoke in the cradle
outcome.answer: Vindicated when the newborn spoke in the cradle

verse: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place. (19:22)
